deviceId.meaning: ID of a PJLink device declared in the carapace profile; HTTP defaults a missing or non-string value to the empty string.

dryRun.meaning: When true, use the profile-backed dry-run path instead of the operation; omitted or non-boolean HTTP values default to false.

fromProfile.meaning: Use the profile product rather than querying the projector; does not suppress catalog writes when dryRun is false. Missing or non-boolean HTTP value defaults to false.

mutation.meaning: Whether the catalog write was performed.

dryRun.meaning: Whether this was a dry run.

entry.meaning: Known product entry; fields include schema, id, deviceId, host, port, manufacturer, productName, otherInfo, class, source, firstSeenEpoch and lastSeenEpoch.

count.meaning: Catalog entry count after a non-dry-run write.

product.meaning: Profile or queried product identity, or null if unavailable.

manufacturer.meaning: PJLink manufacturer value, or null when absent.

productName.meaning: PJLink productName value, or null when absent.

otherInfo.meaning: PJLink otherInfo value, or null when absent.

class.meaning: PJLink class value, or null when absent.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: caduceus-pjlink-device-invalid:<serde error>, caduceus-pjlink-resolve-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-connect-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-read-timeout-set-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-write-timeout-set-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-stream-clone-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-greeting-read-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-write-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-flush-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-response-read-failed:<OS error>. Also caduceus-pjlink-product-scan-invalid:<serialization error>. Also <raw filesystem or SQLite error text>.
